# Implementation Plan: Instagram-Style Profile Setup

**Branch**: `002-profile-setup` | **Date**: 2025-11-01 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)
**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/002-profile-setup/spec.md`

**Note**: This plan was generated by the `/speckit.plan` command following SpecKit methodology.

## Summary

Nova's profile setup enables students to create and manage their profiles with an Instagram-inspired UX. Users complete a streamlined onboarding flow with just 2 required fields (name + class) while optionally uploading avatars, setting pronouns, and writing a bio. The system prioritizes minimal friction, privacy-first data collection, and teenage familiarity through bottom sheets, auto-save patterns, and tap-to-edit interactions. Profile data is stored in Supabase PostgreSQL with Row-Level Security policies, avatar images in Supabase Storage with signed URLs, and the UI implements skeleton loading states, Material Design colored initials for avatars, and replace navigation to prevent setup loops.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: Dart (Flutter SDK 3.x+)
**Primary Dependencies**: Riverpod (state management), Supabase Flutter SDK (backend integration), image_picker (camera/gallery access), shimmer (skeleton loading animations)
**Storage**: Supabase PostgreSQL 15+ (profile data with RLS policies), Supabase Storage (avatar images with CDN), Hive/SharedPreferences (offline local storage)
**Testing**: Flutter test framework, widget tests, integration tests
**Target Platform**: iOS 15+ and Android 8.0+ (cross-platform mobile)
**Project Type**: Mobile (Flutter feature-first clean architecture)
**Performance Goals**: Setup screen loads <500ms, avatar upload <2s p95, 60fps sustained animations, instant search <50ms for 35 items
**Constraints**: Offline-capable (local save with sync), skeleton loading states, replace navigation (no back to setup), WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility
**Scale/Scope**: 500+ students at Liceo Galilei Moro, 35 classes (SCIENTIFICO + CLASSICO), 5MB max avatar size, 150 char max bio

## Constitution Check

*GATE: Must pass before Phase 0 research. Re-check after Phase 1 design.*

### Principle 1: STUDENTS_FIRST ✅ PASS

- **Teen-friendly UX**: Instagram-inspired patterns (bottom sheets, tap-to-edit, auto-save) that 14-19 year olds already know
- **Minimal friction**: Only 2 required fields (name + class), skip option available, setup completes in <1 minute
- **Language**: Italian UI text ("Seleziona classe", "Salva e inizia") appropriate for Italian high school students
- **Autonomy**: Skip option respects student choice to explore before committing
- **Student benefit**: Profile enables full participation in Nova (events, comments, chat) - core value delivered

### Principle 2: PRIVACY_FOUNDATION ✅ PASS

- **Minimal data**: Only name + class required; avatar, pronouns, bio fully optional (no Instagram handle collected per clarification)
- **No tracking**: Zero third-party SDKs, no analytics beyond aggregate usage
- **RLS policies**: Supabase Row-Level Security enforces student-only visibility (`auth.email LIKE '%@galileimoro.edu.it'`)
- **Signed URLs**: Avatar URLs expire after 1 hour, not permanently public
- **GDPR compliant**: Right to Access (data export), Erasure (account deletion), Rectification (edit profile), Data Portability (JSON export)
- **Pronouns privacy**: Default "Non specificato" stored as NULL, opt-in required, visible only to authenticated students

### Principle 3: SIMPLICITY_FIRST ✅ PASS

- **Single screen**: No multi-step wizard complexity, all fields on one screen with clear visual hierarchy
- **5 total fields**: 2 required (name, class) + 3 optional (avatar, pronouns, bio) - not overwhelming
- **Auto-save**: Eliminates explicit "Save" buttons for edits (only "Salva e inizia" on first setup)
- **No feature bloat**: Profile setup is essential MVP feature (enables participation), not nice-to-have

### Principle 4: PERFORMANCE_FIRST ✅ PASS

- **Load time**: <500ms setup screen load (NFR-001)
- **Avatar upload**: <2s p95 (NFR-002)
- **60fps animations**: Bottom sheet with spring curve `Curves.easeOutBack` (NFR-004)
- **Instant search**: <50ms filter for 35 classes (NFR-005)
- **Optimistic UI**: Immediate visual feedback before server confirmation (FR-009)
- **Offline support**: Local save with automatic sync when network returns (FR-009c, NFR-016-018)
- **Skeleton loading**: Better perceived performance than spinners (clarification Q1, NFR-001a)

### Principle 5: SPEC_FIRST ✅ PASS

- **Spec complete**: [spec.md](./spec.md) written before implementation with 6 user stories (P1/P2/P3), 12 edge cases, acceptance criteria
- **Clarifications resolved**: 5 clarification questions answered (loading states, class format, avatar colors, class storage, navigation)
- **Plan follows spec**: This plan implements spec exactly, no deviations
- **No "document later"**: All requirements explicit and testable before code

### Principle 6: DESIGN_SYSTEM_STRICT ✅ PASS

- **All colors**: References `NovaColors.primary`, `NovaColors.success`, `NovaColors.error`, `NovaColors.backgroundPrimary`, etc. (zero hex codes in spec)
- **All spacing**: `NovaSpacing.l` (16px), `NovaSpacing.m` (12px), `NovaSpacing.s` (8px), `NovaSpacing.xl` (20px)
- **All typography**: `NovaTextStyles.h2`, `NovaTextStyles.body`, `NovaTextStyles.caption`, `NovaTextStyles.button`
- **All radius**: `NovaRadius.circularFull` (avatar), `NovaRadius.m` (cards), `NovaRadius.s` (inputs), `NovaRadius.xl` (bottom sheets)
- **Glass components**: Bottom sheets use `NovaGlassCard` with `GlassLevel.medium` (no inline `BackdropFilter`)
- **Shadows**: `NovaShadows.small` (avatar), `NovaShadows.medium` (bottom sheet)

### Principle 7: CONTENT_MODERATION ✅ PASS

- **Bio sanitization**: Strip HTML tags, remove URLs, prevent XSS (SEC-002)
- **Name validation**: No numbers/special symbols (SEC-004), letters + spaces + hyphens + apostrophes only
- **Avatar security**: Virus scan on upload (Supabase automatic), 5MB max, MIME type validation (SEC-003)
- **Server-side validation**: Max length enforcement (150 chars bio, 50 chars name) mirrors client-side for security
- **No public profiles**: RLS policies ensure only authenticated @galileimoro.edu.it students can view profiles

### Security & GDPR Compliance ✅ PASS

- **RLS policies**: All profile table access requires valid JWT, users can only edit own profiles (SEC-001)
- **Logging**: No sensitive data (email, password) in logs (constitution logging rules)
- **Session validation**: Profile endpoints require valid JWT (SEC-006)
- **Rate limiting**: Max 10 profile updates/min, max 5 avatar uploads/hour (SEC-005)
- **GDPR rights**: Data export, erasure, rectification, portability all supported

### Architecture Compliance ✅ PASS

- **Feature-first**: Code lives in `lib/features/profile/` with data/domain/presentation layers
- **Riverpod providers**: No direct repository instantiation in UI
- **Constants file**: Class list in `lib/core/constants/classes.dart` (hardcoded as clarified)
- **Design system**: All UI values from `lib/core/theme/` constants

**GATE VERDICT: ✅ ALL GATES PASS - Proceed to Phase 0 Research**
